Excellent
Dec 2018 • Couples
The good reviews on TripAdvisor led us to Tomato-Pad Thai and we did not regret it at all, quite the contrary, we are delighted. 
Yes, it is very easy to make your choice, everything is in photos on the walls. Yes, the owner is super friendly and smiling. Yes, the food is excellent. The quantity is absolutely sufficient, it was only out of gluttony that my husband gave in to the temptation of a second dish. The prices are incredibly low. We have never eaten for so little money. The setting is pleasant and you can eat there with complete confidence. Everything is fresh and delicious. It was a great discovery. Absolutely recommended.

Top notch
Sep 2026 • Family
Well… we went back today, just for you, to verify that our opinion from yesterday was indeed reliable… 😏
Well, okay, not at all 😂 We mainly went back because we had already been won over yesterday!
This time, we wanted to try other dishes from the menu, and the verdict: it was excellent once again. Hearty dishes, very good, well prepared and always at really reasonable prices.
Two days in a row, two very good experiences. And always the same lovely welcome from the family that runs the restaurant. ❤️
In short, after a very serious cross-check 😄, we still recommend it just as much!
